question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Privilege
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Disadvantage'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of the word** 'privilege'** is ‘a special right, **advantage**, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group
 
• The meaning of the word **'Disadvantage' **is absence or deprivation of advantage or equality.
 
• Hence, the correct Antonym of '**Privilege'** is '**Disadvantage'**.

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__***

 
• An **Antonym** is a word that means the opposite of another word. For example, hot and cold are antonyms, as are good and bad.
 
• *** ***Lets see the meaning of other given words-
 
 
• Prerogative- A right or advantage belonging to a particular person or group because of their importance or social position so Privilege and Prerogative are synonyms.
 
• **Loss**- The state of no longer having something or not having as much as before; the act of losing something.
 
• **Disabled**- having an illness, injury, or condition that makes it difficult to do some things that other people do:
